items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Leonidow almost cried when they put him out... Leonidow was backed out now... Yes. This was his first venture into -- with jazz, see.

ctx.x: You see, the Swedish people were all nice and like that, but they didn't have the fire the Danes had. And I'm not saying this because you're from Danish extract, either. (laugh)

I'm saying it because it's the truth. And they made us get out of there, you see? They said, 'You can't take any more money.' And Leonidow almost cried when they put him out. That's where they -- where you saw that article there where they called me an orangutan and all like that. Well they were good people & there, (laugh)
